lc_person: G. Charles (George Charles) Walton, born 1966, historian of eighteenth-century France; author of Policing Public Opinion in the French Revolution.
item_person: Charles Walton, born 1966, historian with University of Warwick affiliation; Wikidata identifies him with LC no2003032236.

evidence.says: The authorized heading is Walton, G. Charles (George Charles), 1966-, with variants George Charles Walton and Charles Walton. Its source notes identify G. Charles Walton on the 2003 Policing public opinion in the French revolution title page and Charles Walton on the 2009 book. The 2003 title and year match the supplied Princeton dissertation record. LC cites Princeton University Archives information supporting birth in 1966 and an Into print publisher data view also giving 1966.
The item is labeled Charles Walton and described as a historian. It records birth year 1966, LC authority no2003032236, VIAF 102412525, ISNI 0000000081710346, and employer Q865528.
Q865528, the employer recorded on Q96196210, is the University of Warwick.

The university identifies Charles Walton as a historian of eighteenth-century France, previously at Yale, and lists his 2009 Policing Public Opinion in the French Revolution and edited collection Into Print. These works and the earlier Yale affiliation match the LC source notes.

notes: The name disagreement is explained by documented name variants: George Charles, G. Charles, and Charles Walton refer to the same author. The dissertation title and year directly connect the graph entry to the LC authority. LC and Wikidata agree on 1966; no replacement item is needed.
